title: Live Online AI Certification Cohorts for Engineers | InfoQ
gist: Promotional landing page for InfoQ's paid five-week live online AI certification cohorts (AI Engineering, AI Security & Privacy Engineering, AI-Assisted Engineering) for senior engineers, priced at USD 1,470 with the next intake starting 9 Jan 2027; little investable signal beyond evidence of demand for practitioner AI upskilling.

insights.claim: InfoQ sells five-week live online AI certification cohorts (4 live hours per week, 20 hours total, capstone in week five) priced at USD 1,470 per person, with AI Engineering intakes starting 9, 21 and 22 January 2027.
insights.speaker: InfoQ
insights.so_what: Price point and cadence benchmark the market for senior-engineer AI upskilling.

insights.claim: InfoQ's AI programs split into AI Engineering (production AI systems, RAG and context pipelines, agents, evals), AI Security & Privacy Engineering, and AI-Assisted Engineering focused on the environment around coding agents, including context, permissions, review and unattended workflows.
insights.speaker: InfoQ
insights.so_what: Coding-agent engineering is now treated as a distinct professional discipline worth paid training.
insights.locator: Which AI program should I choose?

insights.claim: InfoQ frames the core challenge in AI engineering as practices changing faster than teams can codify them, with decisions on agents, context, evaluation, security, permissions and reliability being made while practices are still in flux.
insights.speaker: InfoQ
insights.so_what: Immature AI engineering practice sustains demand for training, consulting and tooling that codifies best practice.
insights.quote: AI engineering is moving faster than the playbook.

insights.claim: InfoQ's cohort facilitators include Confluent's Adi Polak, Practical Data Privacy author Katharine Jarmul, Hien Luu and Lan Chu, and the programs target practitioners with generally at least five years of experience who already own AI technical decisions.
insights.speaker: InfoQ
insights.so_what: Positions the offering at senior practitioners rather than entry-level AI education.
